en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a densely crowded public ceremony in front of an ornate European townhouse or municipal building. A large outdoor altar with a crucifix and many candles stands at the top of a staircase, richly decorated with garlands. Clergy in vestments, military or veterans in uniform, and officials gather on the steps, while numerous flags and standards are held by people below. Spectators look on from open windows and from a second building on the right. Bunting and wreaths decorate the façades, and tall flagpoles with striped flags rise on both sides.
